{{Quote|This is Beta Squadron, the way is clear. We are moving in to the excavation site.|Beta Squadron|<ref name="CWVG">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref>}}
'''Beta Squadron''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] military unit that saw action on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]. It comprised of three [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TEs]] and two [[All Terrain Experimental Transport|AT-XTs]].

==History==
Beta Squadron was among the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] forces participating in the assault on an excavation site where the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] sought to recover the [[Force Harvester]], an instrument vital to powering the [[Dark Reaper]], an ancient sith weapon. While the [[Alpha Company (Raxus Prime)|main force]] mounted a direct assault on the front led by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Beta Squadron took an alternate route to the base perimeter where they waited on the opposite side of a force field gate.<ref name="CWPOSG">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

When Alpha Company blasted there way into the site, they engaged the remaining [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces while Kenobi destroyed a [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]], lowering the gate and allowing Beta Squadron inside. With the fighting over and the site secured, Dooku took the opportunity to present himself in the open in the hopes Skywalker would pursue - which he did. As Kenobi called after his [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]], a [[Protodeka]] revealed itself and quickly destroyed the republic forces in the area, including all of Beta Squadron. After a tense skirmish, Kenobi managed to destroy the massive tank in which he was then briefed by troopers that the Separatist had already found whatever they were searching for.<ref name="CWVG" />
